name: Practised Touch
description: Run a practised palm over an ally's fresh wound and seal it with a measured flow of qi.

name: Settling Warmth
description: Rest both hands on a shocked ally's chest and let steady warmth bring the breath and colour back.

name: Wound Reading
description: Read an ally's injury with a sweep of qi and learn its depth and its cause and what it has torn.

name: Rousing Blow
description: Strike with vitality gathered at the fist and leave a pulse in the target's body that blurs its next move.

name: Fever Lift
description: Lift a clinging fever from an ally by drawing the sickness out through the palms in a slow steady pull.

name: Resilient Guard
description: Thicken vitality into a wall before the chest that rebounds a heavy cut and cushions the bone beneath.

name: Heartrise
description: Press the heel of the hand over an ally's stilled heart and drive vitality in to restart the beat within a few breaths.

name: Wide Reknitting
description: Spread a wide field of mending warmth over the wounded around the user so every cut within reach slowly closes.

name: Restful Draw
description: Draw the strain out of an ally's aching shoulders with a long smooth stroke of warm qi.

name: Calm Knit
description: Knit a deep scratch of an ally while slow breaths of qi quiet the shaking that follows pain.

name: Bolstering Pulse
description: Beat a firm pulse of vitality into an ally's chest so a faint heart strengthens before the next exertion.

name: Vital Hop
description: Bounce off the ball of the foot with a spring of vitality to clear a low strike and land ready.

name: Clean Marrow
description: Cleanse the bones of an ally of a creeping rot by passing clean qi through the marrow.

name: Reknit Muscle
description: Reweave a badly torn muscle of an ally with glowing threads of qi from end to end.

name: Quill Surge
description: Fire a quill of hard vitality from the finger into the soft joint of the target's armour.

name: Lungwake
description: Seal the mouth of an ally who has stopped breathing and drive vitality in to start the lungs again within a few heartbeats.

name: Living Aegis
description: Wrap an ally in a lasting aegis of woven vitality that blunts blows while the ally is tended.

name: Reaching Warmth
description: Hold a hand out toward a wounded ally at arm's length and let warmth cross the gap to seal the wound.

name: Distant Knit
description: Send a thread of qi across a room to knit the gash of an ally who cannot be touched.

name: Offered Balm
description: Open the palm over a stranger's ache and let a measure of vitality flow out to ease it.

name: Vigor Wash
description: Let the field of qi around the body feed vitality to every ally within it so each moves with fresh strength.

name: Glaring Fist
description: Burst vitality outward from the fist as a pale glare so the blow lands and the glare dazzles the target.

name: Cleansing Wash
description: Fill the field around the body with clean qi that scours stray taint from every ally inside it.

name: Foul Rinse
description: Rinse a muddied qi stream clear in an ally by guiding the user's own clean qi through it.

name: Glancing Bloom
description: Blossom a rounded cushion of vitality at the point of impact so a strike slides away at a slant.

name: Pulsecall
description: Cast a pulse of vitality across the field into the still chest of a fallen ally to start the heart again.

name: Vitality Lance
description: Drive the field's vitality into one hard lance that pierces armour and saps the target's strength as it passes.

name: Radiant Touch
description: Brighten the palm with vitality and lay it on a wound so the glow sinks in and the flesh knits.

name: Pulse Share
description: Match the beat of the user's heart to an ally's and share the surplus until the ally's pulse steadies.

name: Lifeglow Sounding
description: Read the colour of an ally's faint inner glow to tell which organs are failing and how fast.

name: Bright Boost
description: Flash a bright boost of vitality into an ally so strength and spirit surge for the next few exchanges.

name: Haloring
description: Spin a thin halo of vitality about the head and shoulders to catch glancing cuts and stray fragments.

name: Sweat Purge
description: Sweat a mild poison out of an ally by warming the body until it leaves through the skin.

name: Mending Beat
description: Beat steady waves of mending qi into an ally's chest to close a deep wound one pulse at a time.

name: Staggering Beat
description: Strike the pulse in a target's throat with a sharp burst of qi that breaks its stance and focus.

name: Heartwake
description: Cup the stilled heart of a fallen ally with both hands and wake it with slow pulses of vitality.

name: Radiant Burst
description: Burst the stored vitality out of the body in a ring of light that hurls back everything pressing close.

name: Physician's Hand
description: Lay a trained hand on a wound and close it with a single practised flow of qi.

name: Splint Warmth
description: Hold a broken limb straight and warm the break with qi so the bone begins to set.

name: Pulse Charting
description: Chart the rhythm of an ally's pulse in three places at once to find the cause of a hidden ailment.

name: Steadying Hold
description: Grip an ally's shoulder and send a steadying flow of vitality into the frame so the ally stands firm.

name: Nerve Jab
description: Land a precise jab on a nerve cluster with vitality gathered at the fingertips to numb the limb.

name: Taintscorch
description: Burn the foulness out of a cursed or tainted wound with a bright flush of qi from the palm.

name: Shielded Treatment
description: Cast a quick shell of vitality over a wounded ally to take a blow meant for the ally.

name: Closing Surge
description: Surge qi into a spurting wound of an ally so the vessel seals in the space of a breath.

name: Lifecall
description: Call the departing life of an ally back by pouring vitality into the body in rhythm with the failing pulse.

name: Purging Veil
description: Draw a veil of vitality over the body that burns away poison and taint before they can enter.

name: Hurried Knit
description: Close an ally's cut on the move with a quick pass of two glowing fingers.

name: Running Warmth
description: Keep pace beside a wounded ally and feed warmth into the wound through a steady hand on the back.

name: Lungfill
description: Open an ally's lungs with a brisk push of qi so the breath comes deep after a hard run.

name: Pace Gift
description: Share the user's rhythm with an ally through a held wrist so both keep the same tireless pace.

name: Skipping Step
description: Skip two quick steps on bouncing vitality to reach a fallen ally before the next blow lands.

name: Snapping Palm
description: Snap the palm open against the target's wrist so a pulse of vitality numbs the grip.

name: Rinsing Hand
description: Pass a cleansing hand down an ally's body to sweep off clinging taint and the sourness of bad air.

name: Turning Skin
description: Turn the skin slick with vitality so a cut glides off at a slant and finds no purchase.

name: Binding Blow
description: Hit the nerve of the target's arm with a coil of qi that locks the limb for a breath.

name: Heartsurge
description: Drive one mighty surge of vitality through the chest of a fallen ally to jolt the heart back to its beat.

name: Twinflow
description: Chain a closing pass over a wounded ally into a vitality strike on the foe in one unbroken sweep of the hands.

name: Streamwarm
description: Run a stream of warm vitality along the length of an ally's wound until the flesh meets and holds.

name: Tendon Ease
description: Ease a locked tendon of an ally with a long smooth pull of qi from elbow to wrist.

name: Clot Sensing
description: Watch the eddies of vitality about an ally and feel the places where they slow and clot.

name: Quiet Shell
description: Pull a quiet shell of qi tight about a wounded ally to keep stray cuts from reaching the flesh.

name: Clearing Stream
description: Send a clear stream of vitality through an ally's veins to wash out a swallowed poison.

name: Mending Stream
description: Pour a mending stream into an ally's torn side until muscle and skin reunite along the wound.

name: Stream Fist
description: Drive the fist forward on a thick stream of vitality that lands with a heavy surging weight.

name: Return Stream
description: Open the second stream into a failing ally's body and flood the empty vessels so the heart takes up its beat.

name: Holding Stream
description: Wrap a thick stream of vitality around a target's limbs to hold it fast while the wounded are tended.

name: Brisk Knit
description: Close a cut in the open air with a brisk pass of the thumb while qi flows through it.

name: Chill Chase
description: Chase the numbing cold out of an ally's limbs with a flush of warm vitality from the palms.

name: Chest Hearing
description: Listen with the palm on an ally's ribs to hear the wet rasp of a hurt lung.

name: Bracing Breath
description: Share a deep bracing breath with an ally so the lungs fill and strength steadies for the hard work ahead.

name: Stout Guard
description: Plant the feet wide and draw vitality up to wall off the front of the body against a shove.

name: Venom Pull
description: Pull venom from a bite on an ally by drawing its heat to the surface with a ring of qi.

name: Warm Wrap
description: Wrap an ally's wounded limb in a thick layer of warm qi that mends it while the ally keeps walking.

name: Vigor Needle
description: Dart a needle of vigor from the hand through the cracks in an enemy's guard.

name: Lungrise
description: Fill the lungs of a fallen comrade with vitality and press the chest in rhythm until it moves of itself.

name: Vital Ward
description: Raise a standing rampart of vitality about a wounded ally that holds against repeated heavy blows.

name: Longbreath Knit
description: Hold a long steady breath and pass its qi into an ally's wound so the flesh closes slowly but fully.

name: Burden Easing
description: Ease the dragging ache of an ally's load-worn back with kneading palms and flowing vitality.

name: Stride Reading
description: Watch an ally's stride and read the hidden injury from the small hitch in the gait.

name: Stamina Pour
description: Pour stamina from the user's reserve into an ally across a clasped hand so failing legs recover.

name: Hammering Palm
description: Hammer the heel of the palm into the target's chest in three quick beats of vitality.

name: Stretching Stride
description: Stretch the stride with vitality so a single step covers the ground of three.

name: Fatigue Flush
description: Flush the poisons of exhaustion from an ally's muscles with a long wash of clean vitality.

name: Slippery Hide
description: Slick the skin and slip a heavy blow away at an angle before its force can settle.

name: Deep Knitting
description: Knit a deep chest wound of an ally from the inside out with a slow weave of bright qi.

name: Return Beat
description: Slam a single hard pulse of vitality into a still chest to force the heart back into its beat.

name: Skewering Thorn
description: Skewer a target's shoulder with a narrow spear of vitality that saps the strength of the arm.

name: Open Warmth
description: Open both palms over an ally's chest and let a broad wash of warmth ease the aches within.

name: Wide Knit
description: Widen the reach of the knitting qi so several small cuts across an ally's back close together.

name: Stomach Calm
description: Calm an ally's cramping stomach with a slow press of the palm and a thread of warm qi.

name: Life Count
description: Count the living pulses within a short span and sense which are weak and which are strong.

name: Shared Vigor
description: Send vitality out to the whole group so every member breathes easier and moves with less strain.

name: Rousing Palm
description: Slap the open palm onto the target's collarbone so a sharp pulse of vitality rocks its balance.

name: Taint Scour
description: Scour a deep-set taint from an ally's blood with repeated rinsing waves of clean qi.

name: Marrow Scour
description: Reach into an ally's bones and scour out the dull ache of a draining curse.

name: Curtain Ward
description: Draw a curtain of vitality across the front of the group to take the edge off thrown missiles.

name: Thorn Palm
description: Spike the palm with hardened vitality and drive it into the soft flesh below the target's ribs.

name: Lifereturn
description: Cast a great slow wave of vitality over a fallen comrade to carry the departing breath back into the body.

name: Sweeping Renewal
description: Cast a great sweep of renewal over a whole company so every wounded member draws a deep breath and mends.
